mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_base ( member_no, member_name, phone, email, password, member_status_code, regist_id, regist_date_time, modify_id, modify_date_time ) VALUES ( #{memberNo}, #{memberName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{password}, #{memberStatusCode}, #{registId}, #{registDateTime}, #{modifyId}, #{modifyDateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT member_no, member_name, phone, email, password, member_status_code, regist_id, regist_date_time, modify_id, modify_date_time FROM member_base
SELECT member_no, member_name, phone, email, password, member_status_code, regist_id, regist_date_time, modify_id, modify_date_time FROM member_base WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE member_base SET member_name = #{memberName}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, password = #{password}, member_status_code = #{memberStatusCode}, modify_id = #{modifyId}, modify_date_time = #{modifyDateTime} WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}
